item.title: Hoggard downs Willow Spring 58-38 to advance to state title game
item.description: After two years of losing in the East Regional championships, Hoggard girls basketball made the third time the charm as they downed Willow Spring 58-38 on Wednesday to advance to the state title game for the first time in program history.

item.title: Wilmington music program hopes to bring the magic of instruments at an affordable cost
item.description: Brooklyn Arts Music Academy is an after-school program that teaches kids of all ages music, at an affordable cost.

item.title: North Carolina Governor Josh Stein expected to visit Wilmington and surrounding areas
item.description: North Carolina Governor, Josh Stein, is expected to visit the Wilmington area tomorrow, March 5, 2026. Stein will be joined by the Secretary of Environmental Quality, Reid Wilson.

item.title: Lou Holtz, college football staple who coached Notre Dame to 1988 national title, dies at 89
item.description: Lou Holtz never met an opponent that couldn't beat him. Somehow, he squeaked out nearly 250 wins and a national title while cementing himself both as one of the most lovable and unlikable characters in college football — a one-of-a-kind iconoclast in a profession brimming with originals.

item.title: Another Chadbourn town council meeting ends early as leadership turmoil continues
item.description: It was the council's regularly scheduled monthly meeting, but moments before it started, Mayor Phillip Britt received notifications that half of the board would not be there, with the meeting ending after just 6 minutes.

item.title: Protester, three Capitol Police officers treated for injuries after scuffle in Senate hearing room
item.description: A protester and three U.S. Capitol Police officers were treated for injuries in a Senate office building on Wednesday after the protester resisted arrest for disruptive behavior and grabbed onto a doorway as the officers and a Republican senator tried to drag him out of the room.

item.title: Hoggard beats Laney 51-33, reaches state for first time since 1970
item.description: In their fourth matchup this season, top seeded Hoggard bested Carolina Coast Conference champion Laney 51-33 in the Class 8A Regional Championship on Wednesday.

item.title: What to know about how GLP-1 medications might fight addiction
item.description: The blockbuster GLP-1 drugs that have reshaped the treatment of diabetes and obesity may help prevent multiple substance use disorders — and reduce the tragic outcomes they cause, a large new study finds.

item.title: Former UNCW athlete alleges head coach shoved her, details ‘downward spiral’ in social media post
item.description: In a statement on her Instagram, Smith alleges that during the road game at Towson, back in January, she had an altercation with head coach Nicole Woods, who two-handed shoved her.

item.title: NC Utilities Commission holds public hearing for Duke Energy’s resources plan
item.description: The hearing is the second in a series held throughout the state by the state Utilities Commission for the public to give feedback on Duke Energy's Carolinas Energy Resource Plan.
